# What do you really earn per wedding? Real hourly pay, yearly net and the fee that hits your target

> Free wedding officiant fee calculator: your fee, ceremonies a year, consultation, script writing, rehearsal, driving and yearly costs become real hourly pay, yearly net, break-even ceremonies and the fee that reaches your target. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
